findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: navigate, search, live-search, route, execute, get_thread, get_account · Private data: navigate, get_thread, show_ui, get_account · Public sink: navigate, search, live-search, route, execute, get_account · Destructive: navigate, execute.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: navigate, search, live-search, route, execute, get_thread, get_account · Private data: navigate, get_thread, show_ui, get_account · Public sink: navigate, search, live-search, route, execute, get_account · Destructive: navigate, execute

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
